description: Spike 2 (irl-subt-0i6.2) showed that WebGPU works in the Even Android WebView, but the page is never cross-origin isolated there, so WASM is single-threaded. Which target is faster depends on the device and the model. Add a Settings > Models 'Model compute' choice: Automatic (today's selectTarget: benchmarks, manifest, power policy), WebGPU, or CPU, with a note that results vary by phone and model. Models that can only run one way (Silero VAD and Moonshine Streaming are CPU only; summary LLMs and Whisper Large-v3-Turbo are GPU only) ignore it. WebGPU falls back to CPU when there's no GPU or a load fails. Changing it reloads warm live models. en and ja strings.
title: Settings: let the user choose WebGPU or CPU for local models, with a your-mileage-may-vary note
